This is the strongest-sourced candidate — it survived a 188-anomaly screen on this asset class — but the published effect spans the overnight session and this engine is flat every night. If the drift is overnight (see the overnight decomposition in the same run), the intraday leg should find nothing EVEN IF the effect is entirely real.
